full_script: [curious] Dos opciones en cada frase. Elige antes de que yo la diga. She looks like her mother. He works as a teacher. It tastes like chicken. Ahora, nivel intermedio. Do as I say. I used my coat as a blanket. There's no place like home. As I said before, it's free. Y ahora, nivel experto. She's not as tall as her brother. It's as if he didn't care. As a child, I lived in Peru. Si llegaste a la tres, eres nivel básico. Hasta la siete, intermedio. Y si sabías las diez, eres experto. [excited] ¿Hasta qué número llegaste? Cuéntamelo en los comentarios.
